description: She wears a deep plum-purple floor-length gown with a low square neckline, fitted paneled bodice, elbow-length sleeves and a full skirt. Gold-toned geometric woven borders outline the neckline, straps, sleeve cuffs, waist and long vertical skirt opening. Round decorative clasps sit at the bodice straps and center waist. A cream-and-gold patterned wrap rests loosely around her forearms and hangs along both sides. A pale cream patterned underdress panel appears at the lower front, and a purple embroidered closed shoe is visible under the hem. Small pendant earrings, a delicate necklace and a bracelet complete the outfit. Opaque fabrics have a textured woven appearance; exact fibers are uncertain. Upper chest and forearms are exposed, with torso and pelvis fully covered.
